command_and_receipt_contract.source_authority: P05 ingress DiagnosticArray header is actual driver receipt SimTime and event seq; navigation Twist has no header. Never substitute bag receipt or coordinator visible clock as exact driver activation.
command_and_receipt_contract.required: Prove sole publishers and complete transport connections before zero bootstrap. Check source/caller/payload/order/count across public command, relay and driver ingress, full finite6DOF and exact planar restrictions; duplicate identical payloads count individually, no nearest-value matching. Check actual raw ingress dispositions/seq and no unexpected ackerman_vel/service writes. Keep separate stamps for trace visible time, driver receipt and actuator source state.
command_and_receipt_contract.limits: Driver acceptance is enqueue evidence, not actual force activation or measured response. No UUID exists in old Twist; order/count under trusted sole FIFO streams is the supported association. All-trace join is not assumed because final shutdown zero has no trace; bounded measured interval and paused drain/tail writes must be explicitly closed in new collector before release.
command_and_receipt_contract.implementation_status: new B05 raw command transport join and physical containment pending; no live qualification from these requirements alone

capture_contract.collector: new B05 version, never edit B04; sole spawn/unpause/pause. Exactly bound process roster/ELF roles and gateway; no reset/delete/set-model-state/runtime unload
capture_contract.startup: paused essential recorder/command connections first; positive-clock planner TF/defaults/full parameters/rear receipts readiness before fixed5s activation; no circular lazy-topic barrier
capture_contract.drain: inherited total5s includes stop,pause,source watermark,source joins,process/parameter RPC and handshakes; callback freeze under one lock before pass decision
capture_contract.failure: B03 partial-batch earlier rear publication without receipt remains failure-inclusive integrity failure; do not fabricate receipt or retry. Independent bag and collector source payload/caller equality required. No-gate and early faults preserve all available artifacts.

stopping_and_accounting.initial_gate: first4 rows are two counterbalanced clear blocks; any invalid completion or integrity/physics failure closes this qualification design; later rows retired without retry
stopping_and_accounting.remaining_static: a timeout/algorithm stop with valid capture and no physical-safety fault may continue to next predeclared identity, but remains a failed qualification row. Any contact/clearance/physical integrity/process/source fault ends stage and retires remaining identities. No replacement or opportunistic schedule edits.
stopping_and_accounting.row_metric: valid goal only uses actual common-source elapsed; timeout, algorithm, safety or infrastructure failure uses22s in attempted failure-inclusive table; preserve reason, raw geometric arrival and invalid completion separately
stopping_and_accounting.retirement: Unstarted rows have no phase or fake observed metrics. All-schedule administrative-cap sensitivity assigns22s while attempted means and pair completeness are reported separately. Incomplete matrix can never pass qualification.
stopping_and_accounting.qualification: all20 attempted at attempt1, all20 capture/parameter/reference/physical safety gates pass and public valid goals reached; baseline-specific failures disclosed without redefining gates
stopping_and_accounting.analysis: descriptive counts, per-geometry/seed pairs and failure-inclusive times; no confidence-superiority test, winner, formal result or posthoc tuning
